programs.title: Paramedics
programs.desc: A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who has crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon celebrate a fun career milestone.

programs.title: Paramedics
programs.desc: Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high risk intervention on a seizure patient. Cullen races to a man with horrific injuries from a horrific crash.

programs.title: Paramedics
programs.desc: Emergency responders face real-life crises, including accidents, medical emergencies, and rescue operations. The show follows paramedics, police, and firefighters as they handle high-pressure situations. Through real footage and firsthand accounts, it reveals the intensity and urgency of emergency services.
